epics.title: Fraud Detection and Alerts
epics.description: The system must proactively monitor transactions for suspicious activity and notify users and internal teams in real time.

requirements.title: Real-Time Transaction Monitoring
requirements.description: All transactions must be evaluated against a fraud detection ruleset in real time before being approved or flagged.
acceptance_criteria: Every transaction is scored by the fraud engine before completion
Transactions flagged as high-risk are held for manual review
Flagged transactions notify the user via push notification and email
Fraud engine response time does not exceed 300ms

requirements.title: Fraud Alert Latency
requirements.description: Fraud alerts must be delivered to the user within 10 seconds of a suspicious transaction being detected.
acceptance_criteria: Push notification delivered within 10 seconds of flag
Email alert delivered within 60 seconds of flag
Alert includes transaction amount, merchant, date, and a link to dispute

requirements.title: User Transaction Dispute Submission
requirements.description: Users must be able to submit a dispute for any transaction directly within the app, triggering an internal review workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Dispute form accessible from any transaction detail view
User must select a dispute reason from a predefined list
Confirmation of dispute submission sent via email within 5 minutes
Disputed transaction is visually flagged in transaction history
